summary: Injured skier in the Forest Lakes area near Moffat Tunnel
notes: ART mission 2021-006, paged 2021-01-10 14:29 for injured skier in Forest Lakes near Moffat Tunnel. 35-year-old Boulder resident fell skiing a snowdrift, briefly unconscious, then regained consciousness with multiple injuries and broken bones, unable to move. Multi-agency response (Alpine Rescue Team, Rocky Mountain Rescue, Timberline Fire, Gilpin SO/Public Works/Ambulance Authority, High Country Auxiliary); ~70 mph gusts grounded the helicopter; ~10-hour ground rescue; patient reached ~4:30 p.m., transported ~9:30 p.m. to St. Anthony's Hospital. Row date corrected 2021-01-06 -> 2021-01-10 at run 930 (Alpine PDF paged 01/10/21; Mountain-Ear says Sunday morning; 2021-01-10 was a Sunday; sequential mission numbering 2021-004=01/06, 2021-005=01/08, 2021-006=01/10).
